0.name: Optimal Quantum State Discrimination
0.description: This topic focuses on optimal measurement strategies and algorithms for quantum state discrimination, including POVM-based approaches and theoretical bounds for VQSD and QSD problems.

1.name: Orthogonal Quantum State Measurement
1.description: This topic examines fundamental schemes and conditions for discriminating orthogonal quantum states through measurement, exploring the utility and limitations of various quantum discrimination protocols.

2.name: Inconclusive Quantum Discrimination Strategies
2.description: This topic investigates universal design strategies for quantum state discrimination that allow inconclusive outcomes, demonstrating new frameworks and optimized rates for unambiguous discrimination.
